Character 1: Jason Todd
Eye colour: Bluish-green

Character 2: Superboy Prime
Eye colour: Blue

I’d really love to see them together literally anything is fine. Your drawings of the boys are truly amazing🥺🫶!! Thank you so much for bringing this wonderful to life…

Tokitokoro-sama, I am always captivated by your wonderful works. This time, I would like to request another illustration from you. I would like you to depict Jason Todd, adorned with a golden magical tattoo on his upper body, wielding two "All-Blades" and fighting.
During the battle, I would be grateful if you could depict him with a cool, maniacal smile and his beautiful blue eyes wide open. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my request amidst your busy schedule. I sincerely look forward to your acceptance of this commission.

Character 1: Jason Todd
Eye color: Bluish-green

Character 2: Dick Grayson
Eye color: Blue

Notes: Just wanna see Dick asleep with his head resting on Jason’s shoulder while Jason is reading a book. And - this detail is up to you - Jason might be glancing at Dick from the corner of his eyes, or he might just keep reading his book.
(If it works for the composition, I’d really love to see both of their beautiful front faces👉👈)

Thank you so much for all the amazing artwork you’ve shared with everyone. I really appreciate and wish you all the best tokitokoro🥺🫶.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Igs_NAWW-OBHFoO4nTXLraytXkA9Qr-D

Character 1: Jason Todd
Eye color: Bluish-green
Hairstyle: As in the reference image Jason’s outfit.

Character 2: Dick Grayson
Eye color: Blue

Pose and Expression: Just wanna see brothers in their winter normal outfits together and smile. 

Notes: I have prepared reference image for Jason’s outfit but you’re very welcome to make adjustments based on your own aesthetic if you would like to. I only hope that the red hood can be kept. 
Dick’s please feel free to decide.

Thank you tokitokoro🥺🫶Really appreciate your work.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WxhWRLPGtM6Qi4eiOU8P3P_TWQI2ovGt

Dear tokitokoro

It is a pleasure to meet you. I like your art style and your work very much. I would love to work with you on an illustration.

I would like you to draw Jason Todd (Red Hood Jason Todd). I would like you to draw him in tears as he reads a sad piece of literature. Jason is wrapped up in a soft comforter or stuffed animal, and his clothes and pose are left to your imagination.

Thank you very much for taking the time in your busy schedule to look over my request. I sincerely look forward to receiving your request.

Hi! I’m a huge fan of yours.
I truly admire your artistic style — especially your Marvel Rivals comic cover, which left a deep impression on me.
Apologies that the budget isn’t high, but if possible, I would love to commission an illustration of Loki and Doctor Strange from you. I plan to use it later as a phone wallpaper and a standee (for personal use only).

Any form of illustration is acceptable. Only one character(Loki) or no motif is fine.

If you feel that it’s not suitable or if there’s any issue, it’s absolutely okay to cancel ! I completely understand !

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-lvE5lSZMr3Web_T_ACcL_Yf867Whs73

Hello!

I would love to have you draw Cyclops from the X-Men in a cool pose of your choice. He could be wearing his 90s gear with the brown leather jacket. 

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QjXWqEEgeC4-QlIFm4YMXq2LMflLZL30

Hello! I like your art!
I like how you draw Superboy, Robin, Nightwing and Red Hood!

This is my Vtuber character:
https://www.kirostyle.net/kiro.html
You can use these references for his hairstyle and hair color.

I would like you to draw him in this new outfit: 
https://sta.sh/216n3bvigu57

He is cheerful and athletic.
His hair is black or dark brown.
His eyes are brown.
He likes martial arts and exercising.
He has a strong body.
I would like him to have a confident smile.
You can choose the pose.
I would like a nice view of his muscles, such as his arms, and the sides of his torso.

He has a frog friend.
The frog friend is optional.

I would like a separate version with a transparent background too.
It would be nice if his body was not cropped by the top, left or right side of the canvas.

I would like to use the image in my social media and my videos.
Thank you!

你好！我是您的dc粉丝，非常喜欢您的作品所以想向您约稿。可以帮我画一副关于batman和greenlantern的插图吗？想要hal回到瞭望塔，还飘在宇宙外，bat在舷窗前与他对视，两人手掌隔着玻璃，身影一明一暗。
如果这个构图不合适，让bat用披风盖住hal，两人在雨夜里笑着对视也可以。
背景您可以自由发挥，如果构图都不行，画出您喜欢的他俩的亲密相处模式也没问题，真的很喜欢你的作品，价格不合适可以调整，希望您能够接受邀请！

Hello, sorry to bother you. 
I really like your work and I'd like to request you to draw the Superman and Batman?
You can draw them free but I want Batman without his mask. 
This could be ‘they discussing something together after a night patrol’ or it could be a private afternoon-tea-time with Clark Kent and Bruce Wayne, shopping or hang out...
THANK YOU VERY MUCH!

Hi!
Inspired by Bat-family, eps. Batman/Bruce, in formal wear, I’d like to commission a coloured, full-body shot of Superman wearing a suit, too. Superman in another of his forgotten designs from the 90’s with long hair (and I’m not talking about the mullet).
Could you draw him in an expensive, fine-tailored suit coat with matching trousers? Underneath the unbuttoned coat, he wears a white, tight, yet equally expensive shirt. The top half (≈ 4 buttons) of the shirt is unbuttoned, giving him a huge cleavage. Only the belly should be covered, while the pecs are bulging out as the broad torso pulls the shirt’s fabric.
He wears his hair open/loose and neither a tie nor his glasses, since he appears/acts as confident Superman, not shy Clark Kent.
Maybe he’s attending an event/party, which requires formal wear, but he also wanted to show off the “good stuff”?
Reference: Superman #87 & #88 (1994), art: Stuart Immonen

https://readcomiconline.li/Comic/Superman-1987/Issue-87

Antoine/Top: He's an admired superhero, but also a psychopath.
Branwyn/Bottom: he has a small scar on his face in the adulthood, but no scar in teenage
He's a wealthy philanthropist and a superhero. He has a noble soul and a heart of gold.
Relationship: They are childhood friends who have been studying together since they were young, and Antoine has a strong desire to control Branwyn. Branwyn looks up to the brilliant Antoine and tolerates Antoine's flaws as a psychopath. Their personalities complement each other, and they have fought side by side, but have also been separated by their different beliefs. They maintain a coupled and subtle relationship.

You are free to draw whatever you want, or you can choose one of the following to draw.
-As teenagers, they fight side by side against their enemies.
-As an adult, after their superhero activity, Branwyn tenderly tends to Antoine's wounds.
-Any period is fine. Enjoying dinner together at the end of training or after superhero work.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1frpl9nakh5iZOcQS09A0cxKG4xTmp5nt

Hi!
Since the last piece was marvellous, I’d like to request a new one. This time I’d like you to draw a coloured, full-body shot of Superman in his (forgotten) design from the “Truth” arc (2015–16). During the arc he wears a form-fitting blue T-shirt (tight top, loose bottom) combined with likewise form-fitting black jeans. Together with his short haircut and the stubble it gives him a badass aura. In my eyes, he even acts more badass/brutal/fierce during the arc (loss of almost all powers & secret identity). Since he relies on unarmed combat now, he uses his fists and other kickboxing techniques more often during fights.
How about something like this: Could you draw him in some sort of fight/action scene, where he’s performing a cool move? Some sort of movement, which causes his T-shirt’s lower/baggy part to lift up, so his abs/belly get exposed (some fan service). → Superman #45 (’15), p. 4: t.ly/HCF3w
additional reference: S/WW #18 cover (’15), cover art: Paulo Sigueria: t.ly/FCt8y

https://readcomiconline.li/Comic/Superman-Wonder-Woman/Issue-18?id=32984

Thank you for all your help.
We apologize for the small amount, but we would be happy to ask for any possible content at this price.

Characters we would like: Black Widow, Captain Carter

I would like an illustration with a bouquet or flower motif.
I love the lines you draw, so I am open to color/black-and-white, rough sketch only, single-color line drawing, miniature character, doodle, etc... I would be very interested in your work. Any form of illustration is acceptable.
Only one character or no motif is fine.

If the request is inappropriate or burdensome, you may cancel it.
(Sorry, the request is hidden in the settings of .......)

Thank you in advance.

Hello!
I recently discovered your fanart and really love your style. Your recent work of Tim Drake’s Robin is marvellous. Therefore, I’d like to commission/request a fanart of another great teen romance. The DC romance, which still needs to happen: Tim Drake × Conner Kent / (Red) Robin × Superboy
I was thinking of a full-body, coloured artwork with detailed background. I thought of them both on a date and having fun together, showing the affection they have for each other.
I favour Tim with his longer hair, wearing some neat clothes (shirt and trousers). Conner wears a typical tight T-shirt and some dark jeans.
Reference: Adventure Comics #3 (’09), art by Francis Manapul → Loving Conner’s slightly longer hair—better than his usual Young Justice butch cut.

https://readcomiconline.li/Comic/Adventure-Comics-2009/Issue-3
